item.title: 10 Dead, 11 Injured in Night Accident Involving PSV & Truck
item.description: Images of the accident showed the matatu severely damaged, with bodies spotted scattered on the road as emergency services conducted a rescue operation.

item.title: KRA to Introduce Body Cameras in Fresh Crackdown
item.description: KRA officers have been in the spotlight for a very long time for their conduct with travellers at the customs desk, with concerns over bribery and corruption ever growing.

item.title: KCAA Responds to Construction of Petrol Station at JKIA’s Flight Path
item.description: The clarification comes amidst public scrutiny over the ownership of the petrol station and safety concerns over members of the public using flights.

item.title: Kenya Power Issues Warning to Homeowners Over Meter Reading
item.description: The notice comes as the company continues to adapt to fresh changes in meter reading and billing for customers countrywide, despite several roadblocks.

item.title: NTSA Unveils List of 35 Traffic Offences & Respective Instant Fines
item.description: NTSA said the instant fines framework is part of broader reforms designed to reduce corruption, promote accountability, and enhance road safety in the country.

item.title: KRA Sends Notice to Kenyans Whose Properties Are Withheld Over Unpaid Taxes
item.description: The verification exercise reflects KRA’s broader efforts to improve compliance among members of the public and maintain transparency in its records.

item.title: TSC, ODPP Announces 387 Job Vacancies
item.description: This comes as the country is facing mass unemployment, especially amongst the youth, with statistics at a staggering 67 per cent unemployed, according to the KNBS.

item.title: TVETA Publishes List of Approved TVET Institutions
item.description: The list comes days after KUCCPS opened applications for TVET institutions for the 2000 - 2025 KCSE cohorts who wanted to pursue courses at TVET institutions.

item.title: CS Wandayi Calls for Emergency Meeting Amid Concerns of Fuel Shortage
item.description: EPRA is expected to release new oil prices on Saturday, March 14, with growing concerns of a fuel shortage despite the government saying otherwise.

item.title: Kenya Met Lists 6 Regions to Receive Heavy Rains Over Next 7 Days
item.description: Despite announcing rain in multiple regions, the meteorological department revealed that the amount would be reduced compared to the previous week.
